page_title: Dia | A browser you won't dread opening

sources.entry: Dia Browser - AI-powered browser designed for developers and researchers, offering built-in tools for automation, data analysis, and productivity. It helps streamline workflows by integrating coding, APIs, and AI assistance directly into the browsing experience. #freemium

summary.name: Dia
summary.one_liner: Dia is an AI-powered web browser for macOS and Windows that pulls context from your tabs and work tools to answer questions, summarize, and build shareable outputs.
use_cases: start the day with calendar, inbox, and key links overview
ask questions across open tabs and work apps
prepare for meetings with agenda and docs open
turn scattered notes into a report or slide deck
separate work, freelance, and personal browsing
summary.what_it_does: Dia is a browser that uses AI to work across your open tabs and connected tools such as Slack, Notion, Teams, GitHub, and Google Workspace. Its Morning Brief summarizes your calendar, inbox, and key links at the start of the day. You can ask it a question and it gathers context from across your tools to answer, or ask for a report or slide deck built from that context. It also supports separate profiles with their own tabs, logins, and AI for work, freelance, and personal use, plus named tab groups and saved layouts. The page says data is not sold or used for ad profiles, and that Sync is end-to-end encrypted.
notable: Morning Brief summarizing calendar, inbox, and key links
Ask once to search across tabs and connected tools like Slack, Notion, Teams, and GSuite
Separate work, freelance, and personal profiles with their own logins and AI
Dia for Work adds SSO and admin tools
caveats: Dia for Work with SSO and admin tools is a separate team offering
Available only for macOS and Windows per the page
Pricing tiers are not detailed on the page; freemium comes from the listing
